name: Waypoints Alap tag core
retained: trailing local refiner pipelines on segments and parenthesized groups
changes: Converted selected TypeScript parser methods into standalone JavaScript.
Removed upstream framework imports and all atoms except tags; reviewed local syntax/pipeline imports are added in R1.
Removed protocol resolution/registries, remote/local data sources, regex, DOM/item references, comma queries and upstream macro expansion.
Made tokenization and grammar fail closed instead of skipping unsupported input.
Tightened catalog input to copied tag arrays; macros are expanded separately from validated bounded local definitions into the supported tag/operator/group/refiner grammar.
Added fixed character/token/group limits and private catalog state.
R1 splits strict shared syntax and a generic local refiner pipeline into reviewed modules; whole AST validates before evaluation.
Refiners accept strict arities/allowlisted fields and bounded integer arguments; unique/settings/custom stages remain pruned.
R1 preserves tag-only catalog; sort metadata projection, typed comparison and shared-adapter result order are deferred to R2.

R2 adds copied allowlisted scalars, generic string/number type descriptors with stable natural comparison and missing-last ascending order, explicit evaluation randomness and resolve counts/flags. Bookmark field policy stays outside the derivative.
